title: Time
explanation:
Clock time uses ser. One o'clock is es la una. Every other hour on the clock uses son las: son las dos, son las tres. Spain often uses the 24-hour clock, so son las veinte is 8 in the evening.

A las gives the time of an event: a las tres. Los lunes means on Mondays. Por la mañana means in the morning.
commonMistake: Using es las dos, or using estar for the hour. One o'clock is the only hour with es la.
